evidence: This track starts on the opposite side of the Matukituki River from Camerons Flat.
Ford the Matukituki River at Camerons Flat.
After reaching and crossing the Glacier Burn the track undulates alongside the East Matukituki River until it reaches Junction Flat and the Kitchener River.
This track follows the true right of the Kitchener River and climbs an old unstable slip which is narrow.
The track passes through beech forest to the top of the gorge and ends at Aspiring Flats.

doubts: Shape is one_way because the text says the track 'ends at Aspiring Flats' and gives no return; DOC's time 8–10 hr is the page summary and is not split by leg. The start is Camerons Flat (valley T5) because the car park is across the river from the track start; the two road-end features where East Matukituki Track meets Cameron Flat Road are not clearly the start, so no road-end ref is used. Glacier Burn crossing is not said to be bridged or unbridged, so no how is given there. The Rock of Ages biv is 30 minutes beyond where the track reaches the flats, so it is not on the main way and is not in huts. The alternative access by the Otago Boys' High Bridge is recorded as an access point, not a way.
